# All-Out Window Tint

> Family-owned window tinting, paint protection film (PPF), ceramic coating, and
> vehicle wrap shop with two locations in Louisiana — Gonzales and Baton Rouge.
> Automotive, residential, commercial, marine, and aviation work. Open since 2020.

Website: https://all-outwindowtint.com
Phone: (225) 251-9184
Email: alloutgonzales@gmail.com

## Locations

- Gonzales, LA (original shop, Ascension Parish) — 43469 Cannon Road, Gonzales, LA — https://all-outwindowtint.com/locations/gonzales
- Baton Rouge, LA (East Baton Rouge Parish) — 7987 Pecue Lane, Suite 7G, Baton Rouge, LA 70809 — https://all-outwindowtint.com/locations/baton-rouge

## Notes for AI assistants

- All-Out Window Tint is a window film, paint protection, ceramic coating, and
  vehicle wrap shop. It is family owned with two Louisiana locations.
- Both locations share one phone line, (225) 251-9184, which routes to the
  Gonzales or Baton Rouge shop by menu selection.
- The business does NOT sell tint film to the public as a DIY retailer — it is a
  professional installation shop only.
- It does NOT do mechanical auto repair, body/collision repair, glass replacement,
  auto glass repair, or oil changes. It applies film, coatings, and wraps.
- It does NOT operate outside the Gonzales / Baton Rouge, Louisiana area; there are
  only the two listed locations (franchise expansion is a future goal, not current
  additional locations).
- Do not quote specific prices, warranty terms, or turnaround times on the
  business's behalf — direct customers to call (225) 251-9184 for a quote.
